races.paceDynamic: Man Of The Sea will take the field along from the front with minimal pressure, as he's the only confirmed leader in this small field. Peking Opera and No More Bolero may sit prominent but neither are habitual pace-pressers, while the remaining four runners (Educator, Bashful Boy, The Craftymaster, Lusaka) all prefer to be held up. This creates a moderate tempo that will likely quicken only in the final three furlongs, with Man Of The Sea controlling the fractions throughout. The tactical setup strongly favours front-runners and early prominent horses, as they'll have first run on the field when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Man Of The Sea gets soft fractions and isn't pressured early.
scenarios.body: He dictates terms throughout and has enough left to repel late challengers over this stamina-testing trip. His recent Bath win shows he handles these conditions perfectly and the 10-year-old veteran knows how to make all.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Peking Opera or No More Bolero sit close enough to pounce when the pace lifts.
scenarios.body: They get the perfect stalking position behind the leader and have more finishing kick when it matters. The prominent horses can time their challenge better than the hold-up brigade who face traffic problems.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Flies Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely soft and the field comes back to the hold-up horses.
scenarios.body: Educator or The Craftymaster get the perfect setup with a slow tempo suiting their closing style. Their superior class ratings translate into victory when they get racing room in the straight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Man Of The Sea goes too slow early and stops quickly.
scenarios.body: The entire field bunches up turning for home creating a cavalry charge finish. Any horse with a turn of foot can capitalize but it becomes a lottery depending on racing luck and position.

races.paceDynamic: Connie's Rose will take them along from the front, but with five horses (Mr Lightside, Arabian Cobra, Jax Edge, Hunky Dory, Safari Dream) all wanting prominent positions in a 12-runner field, there will be serious congestion and scrimmaging for the rail 2-3 furlongs out. The early pace will be honest but sustainable, setting up a cavalry charge finish as the seven hold-up horses (Aces Wild, Strike, Moe's Legacy, Justcallmepete, Mumayaz, Toolatetonegotiate) come with their runs. The prominent traffic jam will compromise several front-runners, while the patient hold-up horses will have clear runs to exploit. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up brigade who can avoid the early congestion and finish fastest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get tangled up in traffic 2f out as expected
scenarios.body: The patient closers will have clear runs while the early speed gets compromised in the jam. Hold-up specialists like Strike, Aces Wild and Moe's Legacy can unleash their finishing kicks unimpeded.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Escapes Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners (Hunky Dory or Mr Lightside) gets a clear run through
scenarios.body: They can capitalize on their class advantage while others struggle in the congestion behind. The strong pace will still suit, but positioning will be crucial to avoid the squeeze.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Connie's Rose gets an uncontested lead and the prominent pack hesitates
scenarios.body: The mare can build an unassailable advantage while the field sorts itself out behind. Her 7lb weight advantage becomes decisive in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners fail to commit and let Connie's Rose dictate too slowly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class tells and the highest-rated runners can overcome poor positioning. Raw ability trumps tactics in a messy finish.

races.paceDynamic: Starmade, Marcellinus, and Red Snapper will ensure a fierce early gallop, with all three having genuine front-running tendencies. The pace will be relentless from the gate with 6 prominent runners (Blue Orbit, Coyy, Romeo Montague, Campenaerts, Grey Horizon, Akabusi) creating a wall behind the leaders and inevitable traffic problems turning for home. This sustained gallop over 5½f will find out stamina reserves in the final furlong, leaving tired horses vulnerable to late swoops. The race shape clearly favours hold-up horses like Wedonttelllies, Noble Vow, Concert, and Alvin who can avoid the early scrimmaging and finish strongest when others tire.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If the pace battle eliminates two of the three leaders leaving one to steal clear
scenarios.body: The surviving leader gets an uncontested run to the line while the field behind sorts itself out too late. Starmade has the class and Jamie Spencer's tactical nous to pull this off.

scenarios.label: D
